thread:
maria: Hey team — spotted a few issues in the API ref for /v1/generate. Optional enum fields like `response_format` are listed as required in the examples, and the empty-body example for /classify is wrong (shows {} but the endpoint expects an `inputs` array). I'll open a docs PR, but want consensus on minimal change set.

alex: thanks, can you paste the exact lines?

maria: sure — under Generate > Request params the schema block shows `response_format: "text" | "json" | "tokens"` with no `?` to indicate optional. The sample also shows `response_format: text` (no quotes) which trips the JS snippet rendering/validation.

sam: the SDK snippets already assume `response_format?: string` in TS defs, right? I can patch the JS/TS examples to use `response_format: "json"` and add a short comment.

jen: for classify, current docs show: 
```
POST /v1/classify
{}
```
It should be: 
```
POST /v1/classify
{"inputs": []}
```
The Go snippet fails when `inputs` is omitted (nil vs empty slice). I added a failing test locally.

alex: agree. We should also add a migration note: older clients sending empty body will now 400. Add a one-line changelog entry under Breaking changes.

maria: I'll draft a PR that updates: schema snippet (add optional marker), generate example (use quoted enums), classify example (show inputs array), and update JS/Go snippets. cc @ryan for release notes.

ryan: ack. Please add a tiny migration section under "Breaking changes" with 2 bullets: behavior change for classify empty body, and clarify enum must be quoted/valid.

kate: small ask — run the docs build locally and check snippet rendering; CI doesn't catch bad JSON inside fenced code blocks. Use `./scripts/docs-build` and `./scripts/snippet-lint`.

maria: will do. PR draft will include the lint fixes. If anyone wants to review: PR will be #842.

sam: quick nit — the SDK snippets link in the generate page points to `/sdk/js/examples` but our canonical path is `/sdk/js/usage`. I'll update that in a follow-up patch to avoid a separate docs churn in this PR.

maria: timeline: plan to merge today EOD unless blockers. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

alex: reviewing now. Will leave comments inline for the schema block and the TS snippet.

sam: LGTM on the example changes; I pushed a tiny change for the Go snippet types (use `[]string{}` instead of `nil`).

jen: added a test-case file `tests/fixtures/classify-empty-body.json` that asserts classify rejects a completely empty payload — pushed to PR branch.

maria: merged PR #842. Thanks everyone. :tada:
